description: Brazilian Portuguese glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the Portuguese form used in every file. keep_latin: unused for a Latin-script language. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Harry and Cybil: você, both ways. Harry and Lisa: você (Lisa colloquial: me diz, deixa eu, te). Harry to Kaufmann: o senhor; Kaufmann to Harry: você. Dahlia to everyone: tu with second-person verb forms (virias, deves, apressa-te), elevated and archaic. Harry to Dahlia: a senhora until the last scene, você in the last scene. Kaufmann to Dahlia: você. Harry to Alessa: você. Little Alessa to Dahlia: mamãe, você. Cheryl to Harry: papai.
style.gender: Adjectives and participles carry the speaker's gender (obrigado/obrigada, sozinha, descuidada, chocada): every first-person line needs its speaker (list of scenes in translation-handbook.md). Where the speaker is uncertain the line is phrased without gender (Eu me preocupei com você; Estão me chamando; Isto me dá arrepios).
style.quotes: “ ” for the [ ] of the English; the dash of broken speech is the character — (U+2014), which the English writes as '='.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence is lower case (proper names keep the capital) with its article: 'Há um/uma <name> aqui. Pegar?', 'Usei o/a <name>.', 'Peguei o/a <name>.'
style.names: people are named with the article in speech (a Cheryl, a Cybil, a Lisa) and without it in notes and descriptions; units of the source are kept where they are a clue or a quotation (polegadas), converted in descriptions (90 cm).
style.font: every character of the translation has a glyph in the game font (accents, ã õ ç, º, “ ”, —): nothing depends on the system-font fallback.

terms.Cheryl: Cheryl (com artigo na fala: a Cheryl); chama Harry de papai
terms.Alessa Gillespie: Alessa Gillespie; chama Dahlia de mamãe
terms.Orridge Bridge Control Room: Sala de Controle da Ponte Orridge
terms.basement storeroom: depósito do subsolo (chave: Chave do depósito)
terms.library reserve: acervo da biblioteca (chave: Chave do acervo)
terms.Chemical: Produto químico (ácido clorídrico; a água do sábio)
terms.Key of [..]: Chave do “..” (Leão, Lenhador, Espantalho); Chave de “..” (espíritos)
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: Pistola / Rifle de caça / Escopeta (Balas de pistola, Balas de rifle, Cartuchos de escopeta)
